content.comment_body: Hello, is there a method to establish communication between [product_name] (versions [version_no]) and an Omron PLC for exchanging data?

[product_name] (with [article_no]) communicates over Ethernet TCP/IP using the S7 protocol. The [product_name] ([article_no]) also supports MODBUS TCP/IP. Does the Omron PLC support these protocols as well?
Firstly, which Omron PLC model are you planning to use?
Both Omron and [product_name] offer ModBus support. You just need to configure which device will act as the master and which as the slave.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are looking for a way to connect [company_name] PLC modules (various versions) with Omron PLCs for data exchange. The conversation focuses on supported communication protocols, specifically Ethernet TCP/IP using the S7 protocol, and MODBUS TCP/IP, and whether these protocols allow cross-brand interoperability. The main topic involves ensuring protocol compatibility and properly setting up master/slave roles for effective data exchange.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the [company_name] PLC module should be able to communicate reliably with an Omron PLC to allow data exchange, ideally through a widely-supported protocol.
